style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render placed in an empty white space. Figures are smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and gray, only the key objects in red. 1940s-1970s Italian period details.
avoid_en: logos, badges or emblems of real companies (no bull emblem, no prancing horse emblem), car brand names, readable text or numbers, license plates with characters, detailed national flags, blood, faces resembling real people

ferruccio.desc_en: the tractor maker, a stocky middle-aged man figurine with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short slicked-back dark hair, a thin dark mustache shape, a plain brown leather jacket over a white open-collar shirt, dark gray trousers

engineers.desc_en: the three young engineers, three slim young man figurines with smooth featureless faces (no eyes, nose or mouth details), short dark hair, plain white short-sleeved shirts, dark trousers, no badges or text

cuts.image: 白い空間に、天秤の模型。左の皿に小さな硬貨1枚、右の皿に硬貨の高い山
cuts.image_en: An antique balance scale in the white space: one small coin on the left pan, a tall stack of coins on the right pan; the right side sinks low. A clutch disc part sits in front of the scale.
cuts.en: An antique balance scale in the white space: one small coin on the left pan, a tall stack of coins on the right pan; the right side sinks low. A clutch disc part sits in front of the scale.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、革のジャンパーの男のフィギュアが、長い一本道の模型を見つめている
cuts.image_en: the tractor maker standing at the start of a long straight empty country road model that stretches far into the white space. Calm golden light.
cuts.en: the tractor maker standing at the start of a long straight empty country road model that stretches far into the white space. Calm golden light.

cuts.image: 白い空間の工場の中で、白いシャツの若い男のフィギュアが3人、作業台を囲んでいる
cuts.image_en: the three young engineers gathered around a workbench inside a bright factory diorama in the white space, looking at a blank drawing.
cuts.en: the three young engineers gathered around a workbench inside a bright factory diorama in the white space, looking at a blank drawing.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、3人の若い男のフィギュアがそれぞれ、車の骨組み・図面・ハンドルを持って並んでいる
cuts.image_en: the three young engineers standing in a row in the white space: the first holds a small car chassis frame model, the second holds a rolled blank drawing, the third holds a steering wheel.
cuts.en: the three young engineers standing in a row in the white space: the first holds a small car chassis frame model, the second holds a rolled blank drawing, the third holds a steering wheel.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、旅の車の模型と、低いレースの車の模型が、背中合わせに置かれている
cuts.image_en: Two car models back to back in the white space: a tall comfortable silver touring coupe facing left, and a very low flat race-style car frame facing right. Symbolic contrast.
cuts.en: Two car models back to back in the white space: a tall comfortable silver touring coupe facing left, and a very low flat race-style car frame facing right. Symbolic contrast.

cuts.image: 白い空間に、車の骨組みだけの模型。運転席のすぐ後ろに横向きのエンジンが置かれている

cuts.en: A bare car chassis frame model in the white space with two seats, and a transverse engine mounted directly behind the seats, highlighted in red. Cutaway, educational, no text.

cuts.en: the tractor maker standing with arms crossed, turned away from the bare race-style car chassis model in the white space. Unimpressed.

cuts.image: 夜の工場の模型で、電球1つの下、3人の若い男のフィギュアが骨組みの車に向かって作業している
cuts.image_en: the three young engineers working on the bare car chassis frame at night inside a dark factory diorama, lit by a single hanging bulb. Quiet, secret mood.
cuts.en: the three young engineers working on the bare car chassis frame at night inside a dark factory diorama, lit by a single hanging bulb. Quiet, secret mood.

cuts.image: 白い空間で、革のジャンパーの男のフィギュアが、骨組みの車をのぞきこみ、3人の若い男がそれを見守っている

cuts.en: the tractor maker leaning over the bare race-style chassis model with interest while the three young engineers watch nervously from the side, in the white space.

cuts.image: 白い空間の自動車ショーの会場の模型。大勢の見物人のフィギュアが、1つの台を囲んでいる

cuts.en: A line of several different low mid-engine sports car models with no badges in the white space, the low red 1966 car leading at the front, the others in gray behind it.
